seo.title: Travessia: get paid by clients abroad, in reais
seo.description: Invoice clients abroad, see the fee before you convert and receive reais by Pix. Demo site for a fictional company.

hero.title: Your client pays in dollars.
hero.lead: The invoice goes out in English for your client. The Pix arrives in Portuguese for you, with the fee and the rate already worked out.

clientsNote.text: Paying a freelancer in Brazil? Your invoice comes in English, and you pay by card or bank transfer.

outcomes.title: What changes when you get paid through Travessia
outcomes.lead: Compared with a regular international wire received at a Brazilian bank.

stats.before: At a bank, up to 6% between fees and the exchange rate.
stats.after: One fee, shown before you convert.

calculator.title: How much will I receive?
calculator.lead: Type the invoice amount and see, before anything else, how much arrives in reais and on what day. The rate you see here is the rate you get.
